description: This file defines the RequestToField class, which implements a method operation for the MiniLang framework. It processes the <request-to-field> element, extracting request attributes and assigning them to fields within the method context, with support for default values and expression expansion.

classes.name: RequestToField
classes.description: Implements a method operation that maps request attributes to a specified field, with optional default value and expression expansion.

classes.name: RequestToField.RequestToFieldFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of RequestToField.

methods.name: RequestToField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation based on XML element attributes, validating and setting up expression expanders and accessors.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation: retrieves a request attribute, applies default if necessary, and stores it in the specified field.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <request-to-field> element with its attributes.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a new RequestToField instance from XML element and method context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this factory, 'request-to-field'.
